messages:
Ivy (docs): Drafted a short PR adding a DSR/retention note and an example export row showing pseudonymization + export integrity fields. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/621
Liam (eng): Nice. Is the integrity field intended to be an HMAC or a checksum? We should avoid prescribing crypto in docs.
Ivy (docs): Right — example shows an opaque "export_signature" field but wording says: "signed or checksummed by export pipeline (implementation detail)".
Priya (legal): Good. Also: when we discuss DSRs (data subject requests) mention that exports may omit or mask data per retention/delete flags. Use "pseudonymized or redacted" language.
Zoe (privacy): Suggest adding a sample flag on the row: "dsr_action":"deleted" | "redacted" | "none" so implementers see possible values.
Liam (eng): We emit a "deleted_at" timestamp for deletions; add that as optional in the example. Also add "export_id" and a short CSV->JSON mapping table.
Ivy (docs): Current example in PR (fenced):```json
{"__meta":{"export_id":"exp-2025-09-01-01","export_time":"2025-09-01T01:00:00Z","export_signature":"opaque:abc123"},"timestamp":"2025-09-01T00:59:59Z","hashed_actor_id":"sha256:deadbeef...","actor_type":"user","event_type":"session.start","ip":"<redacted>","dsr_action":"redacted","deleted_at":null,"details":{"client":"python","version":"1.2.0"}}
```
Priya (legal): That sample is fine. Add a short caveat: "Public examples show pseudonymized values; actual customer exports reflect tenant settings and may include tenant-controlled identifiers."
Zoe (privacy): Can we include a one-line SDK helper (pseudo-code) showing how to map old user_id -> hashed_actor_id without prescribing hash algo? E.g.:```python
# pseudo: pseudonymize identifiers for docs example
def pseudonymize(id):
    return 'hashed:' + pseudo_hash(id)
```
Liam (eng): Good idea. I'll drop a non-op pseudo_hash in the snippet and add a comment: "do not use this for production crypto". Also will check CSV header names against runtime.
ci-bot: docs lint: sample JSON fenced correctly; no blocking issues.
Ivy (docs): Thanks — updated PR with legal caveat and the pseudo helper. Requested formal ACKs from @Priya and @Zoe; will merge after ACK + CI green. :thumbsup:
